content.text:
I built `/work/index.html`. `render` reports status OK with no errors or warnings, at the default view and at a 4-hour zoom.

- **Loading:** it fetches the CSV directly from the URL and parses all 263,088 rows in the browser. None are missing `tl` or `rr`.
- **Overview:** the whole of 2020–2024 shows the daily mean temperature as a line and the daily min–max as a band, with a brush for selecting a period. Axis ticks are years and quarters.
- **Detail:**
  - The temperature track and the precipitation track below it share one UTC time axis.
  - Scroll or drag in the detail view to zoom and pan; the overview brush moves to match, and brushing in the overview changes the detail view.
  - Hovering shows the reading under the cursor.
- **Default view:** the 7 days around the hottest 10-minute reading, 36.7 °C on 2021-07-08 14:00 UTC.
- **Zoom check:** I swapped in a 4-hour window for one render (then restored the default) and got 25 readings drawn as individual dots, with ticks every 30 minutes.

```
REPORT
deliverable: index.html
requirements:
  R1: done - daily mean line + daily min–max band of tl for all of 2020–2024, canvas
  R2: done - zoom/pan down to a 2-hour window; single 10-min readings shown as dots, hover tooltip
  R3: done - brushX in overview sets detail; zoom/pan in detail moves the brush back
  R4: done - rr bar track under tl, same UTC x-scale
  R5: done - overview: years/months; detail: multi-scale UTC format down to HH:MM
  R6: done - all 263,088 rows parsed in browser; aggregation (daily, per pixel) done in JS
  R7: done - axis units °C, mm per 10 min, UTC; title; caption sentence computed from data
assumptions:
  - Time stamps are treated as UTC and the axes use UTC (d3.scaleUtc)
  - rr at time t covers the 10 min ending at t; bars are drawn over that interval
  - Default detail period = 7 days around the 5-year maximum tl, found from the data
  - Daily overview bins are UTC days
  - Caption is one main-pattern sentence plus computed facts (extremes, row/missing counts)
limitations:
  - When zoomed out, detail shows per-pixel mean and min–max of tl and per-pixel max rr, not every reading
  - Detail y-axes rescale to the visible data, so their scale changes with zoom
  - A 1-week brush selection is a thin box in the overview; zooming in the detail view is easier
  - Zoom is mouse/trackpad only; there is no keyboard control
```
